name: Lednice-Valtice Cultural Landscape
description: In southern Moravia, the Liechtenstein dukes spent about three centuries reshaping roughly 200 square kilometres into one vast designed landscape. Wander between the castles of Lednice and Valtice and you'll cross parkland, ponds and woods dotted with follies, with Baroque and neo-Gothic buildings set among English-style countryside. It ranks among Europe's largest artificial landscapes.
